profile.headline: Lead, Application & AI Engineering | Healthcare & Clinical AI Platforms
profile.summary:
Engineering leader with 15+ years across healthcare, finance, and media, including four years managing a 19-engineer global organization and the last seven building clinical and AI software inside health systems.
I'm currently a senior software engineer at Waystar building healthcare AI — applying machine learning and generative AI to unstructured clinical documentation so hospitals catch documentation and coding gaps before the claim goes out.
I hire, coach, and retain product engineering teams while owning application design end to end: discovery with clinicians, information architecture and UX, API and data contracts, and the delivery standards that keep HIPAA-regulated systems dependable. I apply AI where it removes friction from clinical workflow, with human-in-the-loop review and PHI governance built in rather than bolted on.
Specialized in: GenAI and LLM integration, RAG and clinical NLP, Snowflake Cortex, AWS, React/Next.js, and enterprise healthcare systems architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building healthcare AI on Waystar's pre-bill platform for hospitals and health systems.
• Build ML, deep learning, and GenAI features on Waystar's pre-bill platform for hospitals and health systems
• Engineer LLM and NLP pipelines over unstructured physician documentation to validate DRG and ICD-10 assignment
• Design physician-in-the-loop review workflows where every AI recommendation carries clinical context and source evidence
• Integrate with EHR and health-system data through standards-based interfaces, prioritizing high-impact records for specialist review
• Own models in production end to end: Python services, APIs, React interfaces, AWS, evaluation harnesses, and monitoring under HIPAA and PHI controls
• Mentor engineers on retrieval, prompting, and evaluation patterns; lead design reviews

positions.title: Senior Systems Data & AI Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built next-generation AI-driven data applications serving 5+ healthcare systems, processing 50M+ daily healthcare records supporting enterprise operations.
• Architected Snowflake Cortex AI solutions with GenAI semantic models, processing 1M+ patient records daily, enabling real-time clinical insights for 500+ healthcare professionals and reducing query latency by 60%.
• Developed Streamlit applications with AI-powered natural language analytics, adopted by 500+ business users for self-service insights, reducing ad-hoc query requests by 40%.
• Built enterprise analytics dashboards using AWS QuickSight and Astrato, reducing report generation time by 70% and enabling 800+ operations team members to access real-time KPIs with <2 minute refresh cycles.
